primitives.name: Canonical Roster Evidence Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Source Proof Needed - canonical roster API ## Product Surface - content/briefs/articles ## Internal Surface - founder roster accuracy cockpit - data quality reports ## Data Model - ValidationError - CanonicalFact ## Ingestion Plan Use read-only source adapters or fixture-based probes first.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{\\text{evidence}}': 'canonical fact with timestamp and source hash', 'S_{\\text{source}}': 'read-only source adapter identifier', 'T_{\\text{timestamp}}': 'UTC timestamp of ingestion'}
primitives.assumptions: Source evidence is immutable post-ingestion; all facts must be traceable to a single canonical source.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F_{\text{evidence}} lacks S_{\text{source}} or T_{\text{timestamp}}

layer2.mapping: Each F_{\text{evidence}} maps to a GSI probabilistic belief node with P(F_{\text{evidence}}|S_{\text{source}})

primitives.name: Conflict Resolution Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: Official current evidence wins unless stale or contradicted by newer official transaction evidence.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'E_{\\text{official}}': 'official roster evidence', 'E_{\\text{stale}}': 'stale evidence flag', 'T_{\\text{newer}}': 'timestamp of newer evidence'}
primitives.assumptions: Newer official evidence supersedes older conflicting evidence under temporal precedence.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E_{\text{official}} conflicts with E_{\text{stale}} and T_{\text{newer}} > T_{\text{timestamp}}

layer2.mapping: Conflict resolution is a deterministic function of temporal precedence and source authority
layer2.telemetry: Conflict resolution timestamp, resolved evidence ID

primitives.name: Validation Audit Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Validation Plan Run roster:audit, roster:verify, roster:conflicts, roster:stale, and test:roster once implemented.
primitives.assumptions: Audit results are binary and aggregate across all roster facts.

layer2.mapping: A_{\text{audit}} maps to GSE state transition triggers for conflict resolution
layer2.telemetry: Audit timestamp, conflict count, validation flags

Failure modes include stale evidence (E_stale), missing source (S_source = null), and unresolvable conflicts (C_conflict > 0). The system avoids production mutation through read-only ingestion and fixture-based testing. This architecture supports both GSI's probabilistic inference and GSE's state transitions without introducing logical inconsistencies.
